source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 272 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 272.

PD 272.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 272 was established by Ordinance No. 19612, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 29, 1987. Ordinance No. 19612 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 19612 was amended by Ordinance No. 21339, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 24, 1992, and Ordinance No. 21560, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 10, 1993. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19612; 21339; 21560; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 272 is established on property generally located at the southwest corner of Belt Line Road and Preston Road. The size of PD 272 is approximately 58.278 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19612; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Utilization of the Property must comply with the conceptual site plan (Exhibit 272A). (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Some development is currently built on Tracts A and B of the Property. Development of Tract A must be in conformance with the conceptual site plan. Any further development on Tract B requires a detailed development plan. A development plan for each future phase on Tracts B, C, and D must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permits for construction on those portions of the Property. All development plans must include the site plan requisites listed in Section 51-4.803(d). In deciding whether to approve or deny the development plan, the city plan commission shall follow the standards set out for the director of development services in Section 51- 4.803. All development must be in conformance with an approved development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19612; 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.106. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

At the time of the submission of each development plan after July 29, 1987, a landscape plan for that portion of the Property must be submitted to the city plan commission for approval. The landscape plan must be approved prior to the issuance of any building permit for that portion of the Property. All

landscaping must be installed in conformance with an approved landscape plan within six months of the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any use on that portion of the Property. All landscaping must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.107. PERMITTED USES.

(a) Except as otherwise provided in Subsection (b), the only permitted uses on the Property are those uses permitted in the SC Shopping Center District, as shown on Schedule A (Exhibit 272B), and a temporary marketing use as defined in this article.

(b) In addition to the uses authorized in Subsection (a), on Tract B:

(1) a convalescent and nursing home, hospice care, and related institution is permitted subject to the requirements of Section 51A-4.204(8) of Chapter 51A; and

(2) retirement housing is permitted subject to the requirements of Section 51A- 4.209(5.1) of Chapter 51A.

(c) For purposes of this article, “office use” includes all uses permitted in the O-2 Office District shown on Schedule A.

(d) All uses are subject to the use regulations in Chapter 51. In the event a use is dropped from the code in the future, that use on the Property is subject to the use regulations for the most similar use then in the code. The building official shall decide which use is most similar. (Ord. Nos. 21560; 25711)

sections.title: Kitchen Facilities
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.108. KITCHEN FACILITIES.

For purposes of this PD, each individual hotel room may contain kitchen facilities. (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Temporary Marketing Use
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.109. TEMPORARY MARKETING USE.

For purposes of this article, “temporary marketing use” is defined as a nonresidential structure temporarily used as a construction office, sales office, lease office, or marketing office for uses to be located on the Property. A development plan is not required for a temporary marketing use. (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.110. FLOOR AREA.

For the purposes of this section, floor area does not include the basement, as defined in Chapter 51, nor does it include bus shelter area. The total permitted floor area for all nonresidential and hotel uses on the Property is 2,103,343 square feet. Specific limits for floor area for each tract are as follows:

(1) Tract A. Office uses and temporary marketing uses combined may not exceed 520,000 square feet.

(2) Tract B.

(A) All uses combined may not exceed 1,258,884 square feet of floor area.

(B) All nonresidential, hotel, and temporary marketing uses combined may not exceed 314,721 square feet of floor area.

(3) Tract C.

(A) Office uses, temporary marketing uses, and those retail-related uses permitted in the SC Shopping Center District on Schedule A combined may not exceed 1,280,000 square feet of floor area.

(B) Those uses permitted in the SC Shopping Center District, excluding office uses, may not exceed a total floor area of 20,000 square feet.

(C) All office uses combined may not exceed 1,280,000 square feet of floor area.

(D) All hotel uses combined may not exceed 360,000 square feet of floor area.

(4) Tract D.

(A) All uses combined may not exceed 170,000 square feet of floor area.

(B) All office uses combined may not exceed 20,000 square feet of floor area.

(C) All retail uses combined may not exceed 150,000 square feet of floor area. (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Permitted Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.111. MAXIMUM PERMITTED HEIGHT.

Specific height limitations are shown on the approved height contour and setbacks plan (Exhibit 272C), which indicates height contours and setbacks. No structure may exceed the heights indicated on that plan. (Ord. Nos. 19612; 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.112. MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE.

(a) Maximum lot coverage on Tracts A, C, and D, excluding parking structures, is 40 percent.

(b) Maximum lot coverage on Tract B for any of the following uses or any combination of these uses is 60 percent: residential; retirement housing; and convalescent and nursing home, hospice care, and related institutions. For any other use or combination of uses, maximum lot coverage on Tract B is 40 percent. (Ord. Nos. 21560; 25711)

sections.title: Minimum Lot Area Per Dwelling Unit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.113. MINIMUM LOT AREA PER DWELLING UNIT.

Minimum lot area per dwelling unit for residential structures must be in accordance with the regulations for the MF-3 Multiple-Family District on Schedule B (Exhibit 272D). (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Minimum Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.114. MINIMUM SETBACKS.

(a) Generally.

(1) Residential structures must be set back in accordance with the regulations for the MF-3 Multiple-Family District on Schedule B.

(2) Nonresidential structures must be set back from Preston Road and Belt Line Road in accordance with the regulations for the SC Shopping Center District on Schedule B.

(b) Special setback. All structures, except bus passenger shelters, must be set back as shown on the height contour and setbacks plan.

(c) Bus passenger shelters. Bus passenger shelters have no required setbacks. (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.115. OFF-STREET PARKING.

(a) Except as otherwise provided, parking must be provided for each use in accordance with the requirements of Chapter 51.

(b) The provisions of Section 51-4.301(c)(6) (the mixed use parking reduction bonus) may be used to calculate the minimum number of spaces required.

(c) Remote parking may be located within a walking distance of up to 600 feet from the use served by the remote parking.

(d) On Tract B, parking must be provided for a convalescent and nursing home, hospice care, and related institution in accordance with the parking requirements set forth in Section 51A-4.204(8), and for retirement housing in accordance with the requirements of Section 51A-4.209(5.1). (Ord. Nos. 21560; 25711)

sections.title: Right-Of-Way Reservation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.116. RIGHT-OF-WAY RESERVATION.

A 15-foot-wide easement for a hiking and jogging trail on the south side of White Rock Creek, from Preston Road to the western boundary line of the Property, must be approved by the director of parks and recreation and granted to the city within six months of July 29, 1987. (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.117. ACCESS.

Access points to the Property and median openings shown on the plan are approximate and are subject to the approval of and possible modification by the director of the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.118. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Division 51- 7.300, except that non-premise signs are prohibited. Non-premise signs will be permitted in bus passenger shelters if the code is amended to permit them. For purposes of determining whether a sign is a premise sign or a non-premise sign, “premise” means the entire Property. (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.119. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Development and use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.120. PAVING.

(a) All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering area for parking must comply with the requirements of Chapter 51.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19612; 21339; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.121. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19612; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-272.122. ZONING MAP.

PD 272 is located on Zoning Map Nos. B-7 and C-7. (Ord. Nos. 19612; 25711)
